findings.highlight: there’s less of a guarantee this time
findings.evidenceJa: 今回こそは帰れる保証はない
findings.governingReading: this time in particular, there is no guarantee we will return
findings.explanation: An absolute, climactic absence of assurance becomes merely a lower comparative probability.

findings.highlight: Her reply is gentle.
findings.evidenceJa: 応える声は、あまりにも穏やかだ。
findings.governingReading: the voice that answers is far too gentle
findings.explanation: The excessive, ominously calm quality of Saber’s reply is reduced to ordinary gentleness.

findings.highlight: The voice of one prepared not to return.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺以上に、ここには戻ってこられないと覚悟している声だった。
findings.governingReading: a voice even more prepared than I am for the possibility of never returning here
findings.explanation: The comparison with Shirou and the emotional importance of returning to this house disappear.

findings.highlight: I want to engrave the events in my mind so that I will remember them forever.
findings.evidenceJa: ずっと覚えていられるように、心に焼き付けておきたかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to burn it into my heart so I could remember it forever
findings.explanation: The English supplies “the events” where Saber is fixing the sky and house before her in memory.

findings.highlight: Servant Saber will be returning to her original place.
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントであるセイバーの帰還の時でもある。
findings.governingReading: it will also be the time for Saber, as a Servant, to return
findings.explanation: The English specifies an “original place” that the line does not name, making Shirou’s understanding more cosmologically explicit.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka must be waiting at the gate
findings.evidenceJa: もう門の前にいるようだ。
findings.governingReading: it seems she is already in front of the gate
findings.explanation: A visual or situational inference about Rin’s location becomes a claim that she is waiting there.

findings.highlight: Yeah, let’s go settle this once and for all.
findings.evidenceJa: 決着をつけにいこう、セイバー
findings.governingReading: let’s go settle this, Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s direct address to Saber disappears from their departure exchange.

findings.highlight: quickly destroy the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけ早く聖杯を停止させて
findings.governingReading: stop the Holy Grail as quickly as possible
findings.explanation: The infiltration step of stopping the Grail is prematurely changed into destroying it, blurring the plan’s staged actions.

findings.highlight: an embodiment of the pure gods
findings.evidenceJa: 清浄さを持つ神域の具現
findings.governingReading: the embodiment of a sacred precinct possessing purity
findings.explanation: The mountain’s quality of sacred purity is reassigned to supposedly “pure gods.”

findings.highlight: It smells so bloody that I feel sick.
findings.evidenceJa: 生臭すぎて吐き気がする
findings.governingReading: it is so raw and organic that it makes me nauseous
findings.explanation: Rin’s figurative description of rank, raw life is converted into the smell of blood.

findings.highlight: There is no smell of blood coming from the mountain.
findings.evidenceJa: 生臭さなどない。
findings.governingReading: there is no actual raw or rank smell
findings.explanation: The narrator’s clarification is forced to deny a blood smell created by the preceding mistranslation.

findings.highlight: It just feels strange.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ奇怪なだけだ。
findings.governingReading: it is simply grotesque or uncanny
findings.explanation: A strongly grotesque, uncanny sensation is weakened to generic strangeness.

findings.highlight: I can’t tell if the breathing I hear is mine or the mountain’s.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が息をしているのか、山が息をしているのか判らない。
findings.governingReading: I cannot tell whether I am breathing or the mountain is
findings.explanation: The English adds an audible breathing sound to an embodied confusion about whose respiration is occurring.

findings.highlight: Then. Tohsaka suddenly asks me such a question.
findings.evidenceJa: と。唐突に、遠坂はそんな事を訊いてきた。
findings.governingReading: And then, Tohsaka abruptly asks me that
findings.explanation: The connective is stranded as a malformed one-word sentence.

findings.highlight: I feel fine, but really not… To be honest, it’s beyond my control.
findings.evidenceJa: いや、調子はいいんだが、悪いというか。正直、持て余してる
findings.governingReading: I feel fine, but also bad, in a way; honestly, I have more power than I can handle
findings.explanation: The bodily paradox becomes a syntactically broken self-contradiction and leaves the source’s unstable surplus unclear.

findings.highlight: I can easily project dozens of weapons
findings.evidenceJa: 投影の十や二十は軽い。
findings.governingReading: projecting ten or twenty would be easy
findings.explanation: The explicit ten-or-twenty capacity estimate is generalized to an open-ended plural “dozens.”

findings.highlight: But it’s like having a jet engine inside of a worn-out plane
findings.evidenceJa: 体は落ち着かないというか
findings.governingReading: my body cannot settle down, as it were
findings.explanation: The direct bodily symptom produced by the mana surplus disappears from the jet-engine analogy.

findings.highlight: But it did succeed, huh?
findings.evidenceJa: けどちゃんと成功してよかった。
findings.governingReading: but I’m glad it succeeded properly
findings.explanation: Rin’s relief at a clean success becomes a tentative request for confirmation.

findings.highlight: My face burns up the instant I recall it.
findings.evidenceJa: けどちゃんと成功してよかった。初めてだったから心配だったのよ
findings.governingReading: [no active source proposition]
findings.explanation: The mature English branch inserts an embarrassment reaction absent from the authoritative Japanese scene.

findings.highlight: Hold on. Please don’t talk about it right now.
findings.evidenceJa: けどちゃんと成功してよかった。初めてだったから心配だったのよ
findings.governingReading: [no active source proposition]
findings.explanation: The mature English branch inserts a protest that turns the technical discussion back toward sexual embarrassment.

findings.highlight: I-I know! I feel the same way.
findings.evidenceJa: けどちゃんと成功してよかった。初めてだったから心配だったのよ
findings.governingReading: [no active source proposition]
findings.explanation: The mature English branch invents reciprocal embarrassment for Rin.

findings.highlight: …I’m talking about something else.
findings.evidenceJa: 過程じゃなくて、その後の話よ。
findings.governingReading: I’m not talking about the procedure, but what came afterward
findings.explanation: The mature branch removes Rin’s precise correction between ritual procedure and its subsequent mana allocation.

findings.highlight: the magical energy I’m giving to you and Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに取られてる魔力
findings.governingReading: the magical energy being taken by Saber
findings.explanation: The passive drain imposed by Saber’s contract is recast as Rin neutrally choosing to give her energy.

findings.highlight: Saber is getting less energy now
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの出力が落ちてる
findings.governingReading: Saber’s output has dropped
findings.explanation: A consequence for Saber’s combat output becomes merely a smaller incoming supply.

findings.highlight: OhI see.
findings.evidenceJa: あ、そうか
findings.governingReading: Oh, I see.
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation and spacing fuse the interjection to the pronoun.

findings.highlight: does that mean Saber can’t fight with all her power?
findings.evidenceJa: 思うように戦えないのか？
findings.governingReading: does that mean Saber cannot fight as she wants?
findings.explanation: Restricted freedom to fight is narrowed into an assertion about maximum power.

findings.highlight: The magical energy I’m giving you is small
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに比べたら士郎に分ける魔力は小さい
findings.governingReading: the energy I allot Shirou is small compared with Saber’s
findings.explanation: The comparison explaining why Rin can sustain both contracts disappears.

findings.highlight: so it’s fine.
findings.evidenceJa: なんとかやっていけるわ。
findings.governingReading: I can somehow keep it going
findings.explanation: A barely manageable dual supply becomes an unqualified assurance that everything is fine.

findings.highlight: But we can’t push it.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、無理は利かないの。
findings.governingReading: but I cannot overextend myself
findings.explanation: Rin’s own supply limit becomes a vague collective restriction.

findings.highlight: at the cost of her existence
findings.evidenceJa: 消滅する事を覚悟の上で
findings.governingReading: prepared for her disappearance
findings.explanation: A sacrifice Saber must be prepared to risk is phrased as an automatic fixed cost.

findings.highlight: It’s what Saber said.
findings.evidenceJa: これはセイバーが言いだした事なんだから。
findings.governingReading: Saber was the one who proposed this
findings.explanation: Saber’s agency in initiating the sacrificial contingency is reduced to having said it.

findings.highlight: We run.
findings.evidenceJa: 獣道を駆け上がる。
findings.governingReading: we run up the animal trail
findings.explanation: The difficult upward route through an animal trail is reduced to directionless running.

findings.highlight: We know what we have to do.
findings.evidenceJa: やるべき事は判っている。
findings.governingReading: I know what I have to do
findings.explanation: Shirou’s first-person internal resolve is reassigned to the group.

findings.highlight: go settle the match
findings.evidenceJa: 決着をつけるだけだ
findings.governingReading: all that remains is to settle matters
findings.explanation: The closing sense that these are the only remaining duties is omitted.
